Property offences in Polish powiats, 2024

poland_property_crime_counts.Rd

Counts of property offences ascertained by the police in completed preparatory proceedings in each powiat (county) in Poland during 2024.

Usage

poland_property_crime_counts

Format

Data frame containing 380 rows and 4 columns:

kod_bdl

Twelve-character BDL territorial unit identifier.

kod_teryt

Four-character TERYT powiat code, stored as text to preserve leading zeroes.

nazwa

Powiat name in Polish, including cities with powiat status.

przestepstwa_przeciwko_mieniu

Number of property offences.

Source

Statistics Poland, Bank Danych Lokalnych (Local Data Bank). https://api.stat.gov.pl/home/bdlapi.

Details

This dataset is also available as a stand-alone file in Excel format at https://mpjashby.github.io/crimemappingdata/poland_property_crime_counts.xlsx.
